race.description: Andy Birrell Loves Tassie Racing Mdn Plate
race.comment: MR TOD (2) fought on bravely for third off a handy run here when resuming and then finished closer to the winner in sixth placed last time out 9 days ago. He will be spot on for his first attempt over 1400m and can take this out. SEND ME GOLD (3) ran his best race last prep fresh up and is resuming from a long spell with a couple of solid trials under his belt. The blinkers are off, top hoop Anthony Darmanin is back on, and any market support would add to the confidence. DEER POWER (5) was a beaten favourite in his first couple of starts, then was running on too late here 3 weeks ago, with all of those runs being over 1100m. The extra 300m is the key for this, and he is worth another chance. BIG OLIVE (7) showed some talent last season and will be a lot stronger now. She won her latest trial and could be ready to take a step forward as a 6YO mare. Check the market moves. WOUNDED EAGLE (4) has improved in each run back from a spell, so keep safe here. Top 4 value.
